'''Sonko Fromm''' was the oldest son of the [[Annoo-dat Blue]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Sise Fromm]], the older brother of [[Tig Fromm]], and a member of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]]. As Sise's right-hand [[Gender/Legends|man]], Sonko was assigned to a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] raid but botched it. He was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umax]] but later freed by his [[Parent/Legends|father]], only to be [[Prisoner/Legends|locked up]] in the dungeons of [[Sise Fromm's stronghold|Sise Fromm's own palace]] on [[Annoo (original)|Annoo]] so that Sise could hear him wail in agony. Sonko's fate became widely known as a tale of Sise Fromm's temper.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I liked the older brother idea because it dovetailed two obscure sources nicely and lent real credibility to Sise's ruthlessness.|Abel G. Peña|<ref name="Ruthless Sise" />}}
The existence of an elder brother to Tig Fromm was first implied in text written on a collector's coin that came packaged with [[Kenner Products|Kenner Toys']] [[1985]] Tig Fromm action figure: "TIG FROMM is the younger son of SISE FROMM."<ref name="Tig toy">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Droids (toy line)|pack=Tig Fromm|link=Droids-Tig.asp}}</ref> The tale of Sonko Fromm and his imprisonment on Umax were soon afterward told in a children's book, simply titled [[Droids (picture book)|''Droids'']], that was published by Plaza Joven and released exclusively in Spain.<ref name="Spanish book">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50691360|board=Literature|thread=Obscure Droids and Ewoks comics -- translated by Abel Peña|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-04-26|time=4:11 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171105191827/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/obscure-droids-and-ewoks-comics-translated-by-abel-pe%C3%B1a.50010980/page-3}}</ref> After the book was discovered by author [[Abel G. Peña]], he brought the tale into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] in a [[StarWars.com]] blog entry entitled "[[The Droids Re-Animated]]."<ref name="Sonko lives">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50797043|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-06-15|time=2:57 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316143709/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958}}</ref> He was glad to be able to combine it with the Kenner reference and add credibility to the ruthlessness of Sise Fromm.<ref name="Ruthless Sise">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50801413|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-06-15|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316143709/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958}}</ref>
